articles.title: DWP gives new update on '272-day wait' for Universal Credit reassessments
articles.summary: Department confirms average waiting time for Work Capability Assessment reassessment was 272 working days as of Oct 1, 2026.

articles.title: Major update to DWP payments announced as government U-turn confirmed
articles.summary: Government confirms changes to restrict eligibility for Personal Independence Payment (PIP) could be delayed until after review, instead of November 2026.

articles.title: DWP confirms tough Universal Credit overpayment rules after helpline errors
articles.summary: DWP says Universal Credit overpayments, including those caused by incorrect helpline advice, must be recovered wherever possible. Minister Timms response Oct 23.

articles.title: DWP issues PIP update on regular 'check-ins' for claimants
articles.summary: Department addresses proposals for more regular check-ins via app or online, similar to UC journal, after report on claimant experiences.

articles.title: DWP ORDERED TO REVEAL HIDDEN PIP ASSESSMENT REPORT
articles.summary: Information Commissioner orders DWP to release withheld information concerning quality of PIP telephone assessments, ruling dated 6 Oct 2026.

articles.title: DWP: up to £12.7bn of Universal Credit went unclaimed, averaging £4,700 per family
articles.summary: DWP publishes take-up stats for financial year ending 2025. £12.7bn of UC went unclaimed.

articles.title: New DWP PIP update as claimants could get 'one-off' payment - review this autumn
articles.summary: Spending on PIP stood at £16.3bn in 2019-20 rising to £27.3bn by 2024-25. Review expected autumn 2026.

articles.title: Autumn Budget: LHA freeze continues despite rents up 9% - Resolution Foundation warning
articles.summary: Housing charities warn 120k families face arrears as Local Housing Allowance frozen for third year.

articles.title: DWP sanctions data shows 42% of Universal Credit claims sanctioned in 2025 - FOI
articles.summary: Food bank network reports 61% of sanctioned claimants needed emergency parcels, sanctions correlate with deprived areas.

articles.title: Carer's Allowance overpayments: DWP writes off £20m after admin errors
articles.summary: Select committee hears carers pursued for thousands due to earnings threshold breach they were not told about.
